# Beag Labs — Extended Context for AI Agents

Canonical URL: https://beaglabs.com/
Organization: Beag Labs
Product: Papyrus

## Company and product

Beag Labs builds customer-hosted agentic software for document automation, internal application development and modernization of legacy workflows. The Papyrus product brings together governed agent execution, document processing, and application-building workflows.

## Core workflows

### Document automation

Work with PDFs and office documents, extract or normalize information, and support reviewable, human-supervised processes.

### Internal app factory

Create internal web interfaces and business applications based on existing organizational processes. See https://beaglabs.com/products/papyrus#factory.

### Legacy modernization

Wrap legacy systems and services with modern application interfaces. Examples include terminal workflows and SOAP/XML integration with OpenAPI-based interfaces. See https://beaglabs.com/capability/modernization.

### Governance and deployment

Customer-hosted deployment and operator controls are central to the offering. The specific security posture, integrations, licensing, and supported environments should be verified in the current documentation and agreements.
